source_prompt: Ultra-detailed surreal pharmaceutical research laboratory at twilight, wide cinematic 16:9 composition. Center: a translucent teal glass molecular model of a double-helix drug scaffold floating above a brushed-steel bench, with glowing cyan bond lines and amber atom nodes. Left: a wall-sized holographic dashboard titled "EvidenceGrade AI" in bold white sans-serif, showing a 5-tier grade ladder (A emerald, B teal, C gold, D orange, F crimson) and a line chart labeled "Citation Confidence 2019-2026". Right: a large arched window revealing a rainy neo-Tokyo street with neon kanji signs reflecting on wet asphalt, a red umbrella leaning against the window sill, and a black cat silhouette on the ledge. Foreground: an open leather notebook with handwritten notes "CYP3A4 interaction risk" and a fountain pen, next to a white ceramic coffee cup with a teal lid and a cracked porcelain saucer. Ceiling: brass articulated lamps casting warm pools of light; one lamp has a green glass shade. Background shelves: amber glass reagent bottles labeled Aspirin, Warfarin, Ibuprofen in clean black type, a vintage brass microscope, and a small potted monstera plant with one yellow leaf. Atmosphere: volumetric god-rays through rain-streaked glass, subtle film grain, high dynamic range, teal-and-amber complementary color grade, no logos of real companies, no watermarks, photorealistic mixed with holographic UI.

results.reconstructed_prompt: Cinematic photorealistic interior of a moody, futuristic pharmacology research lab at night, wide 16:9 composition, 3D render with a subtle cyberpunk aesthetic. On the left, a large translucent holographic display panel glows cyan and floats in the air. Its top reads "EvidenceGrade AI" in bold white sans-serif letters. Below that, a subheading reads "5-tier grade", followed by a vertical stack of five colored grade bars: green "A", teal "B", yellow "C", orange "D", and red-pink "F". To the right of the bars is a glowing line chart titled "Citation Confidence 2019-2026", with a y-axis running from 0 to 60 and a rising jagged cyan trend line. The x-axis label repeats "Citation Confidence 2019-2026". In the center, a glowing turquoise glass DNA double helix / molecular ball-and-stick model floats above a brushed stainless steel lab table, with small amber-gold spheres at some of the nodes. In the background, a gray plaster wall holds two floating shelves of brown amber apothecary bottles with white labels. The top shelf reads "Aspirin", "Warfarin", and one blank label, and the bottom shelf reads "Aspirin", "Warfarin", "Ibuprofen". Also on the shelves are binders, test tubes, and small bottles. A brass vintage microscope sits on the back steel counter, next to a potted monstera plant with one yellow leaf in a white pot. Articulated brass industrial lamps hang from the ceiling, several with warm glowing bulbs and one with a green glass shade. In the foreground, an open spiral-bound notebook rests in a brown leather folio with a black fountain pen. The left page has unreadable handwritten notes, and the right page has handwritten text reading "CYP3A4 interaction risk". On the right, a white cracked ceramic coffee cup with a teal lid sits on a saucer. A large arched window on the right side shows a rainy night city street full of glowing pink, red, and blue neon signs with Chinese characters, which are mostly illegible or pseudo-characters, with "酒店" partially visible. On the window sill, a black cat silhouette sits beside a red folded umbrella with a wooden hook handle. The lighting mixes warm lamp glow with cool cyan hologram light and pink neon reflections, with soft volumetric haze, reflective metal surfaces, and rain-streaked glass. The atmosphere is cozy yet high-tech, rendered with shallow depth of field and a highly detailed, octane-render style.
